handled_verified._description: DERIVED BY SOURCE REFERENCE, NOT YET BY PROBE — read this before quoting the list. A type is in this bucket when src/ast/real-vb-analyzer.ts NAMES it as a quoted literal in code position (comments and template literals stripped; .tmp-f48/cov/node-refs.mts). That is a NECESSARY condition for the node being handled and NOT a sufficient one: a name appearing in an evidence-classification helper or a read-side filter is not an emission. The stronger instrument — script/m14/completeness-inventory.ts section A with a `--verify-silence` pass that re-parses live code — has NOT been run for vb, and the only committed proof of emission for this lane is the five fixtures under validation/m14/fixtures/vb/ plus the whole-population run in `coverage` below. Treat this bucket as a worklist with its method declared, not a verdict.

internal_silent._description: The complement of handled_verified: 21 of the 166 distinct named node types are NEVER NAMED by src/ast/real-vb-analyzer.ts. NOT VERIFIED SILENT — several (aggregate_clause/group_by_clause/join_clause/let_clause are LINQ query syntax; date_literal; tuple_expression) look like real content rather than literals or wrappers, which is exactly the class a completeness audit exists to catch. They are listed here so that every named type is in exactly one bucket and none is silently absent; the silence itself is OWED, not measured.

gap._description: NOT A MEASURED LIST. No node-type gap has been confirmed for vb by the audit that confirms it elsewhere (the analyzer-vs-grammar census and its live-silence verification).
